title: Robust root slots for three-level coherent decoding

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the fixed-source-slot algorithm specified in root-slots.md and proof.md has total sequential work O(2^(n/8) n^(9/2) log2 n), exact growth index 1, on every branch jointly with all other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 under the declared fixed-position malformed model.

For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the fixed-source-slot algorithm specified in root-slots.md and proof.md has peak classical bits O(n^2), exact growth index 0, on every branch jointly with all other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 under the declared fixed-position malformed model.

For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the fixed-source-slot algorithm specified in root-slots.md and proof.md has peak qubits O(n), exact growth index 0, on every branch jointly with all other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 under the declared fixed-position malformed model.

For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the fixed-source-slot algorithm specified in root-slots.md and proof.md has total acquired copies O(n^4), exact growth index 0, on every branch jointly with all other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 under the declared fixed-position malformed model.

For every N>=2 and s, the same fixed-source-slot algorithm recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 7/8 jointly with the other bounds when epsilon(n)=1/(8589934592*n^3), with n=ceil(log2 N). Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied. The joint state and positions are chosen before private coins by the fixed-position model.
